AMRN.title: LQDA Settles UTHR Disputes for $380.7M, Limits Yutrepia Label
AMRN.summary: Liquidia Corporation has reached a global settlement with United Therapeutics, resolving all six pending legal disputes and ensuring continued access to Yutrepia for PAH patients. However, the company must pay $380.7 million in settlement obligations across 2026-2027, and the removal of the PH-ILD indication from Yutrepia's label narrows its approved use. AMRN.title: Syndax Stock Falls 16% as Phase II Fibrosis Study Misses Primary Goal
AMRN.summary: Syndax Pharmaceuticals (SNDX) shares fell 15.7% after its phase II MAXPIRe study of axatilimab failed to meet the primary endpoint in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) treatment. The drug showed no benefit in slowing FVC decline, though it maintained a favorable safety profile. The company is discontinuing IPF development but will continue pursuing axatilimab in chronic graft-versus-host disease (cGVHD) with results expected in 2026 and 2028.

AMRN.title: BMY Reports Mixed Phase III Trial Results, Stock Down
AMRN.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb announced mixed Phase III results for admilparant in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, meeting its primary endpoint only at the 60-mg dose while failing at 120-mg, causing the stock to decline 2.6%. However, the company reported positive Phase III results for RYZ101 in advanced gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, demonstrating statistically significant improvement in progression-free survival. The mixed outcomes reflect uncertainty about admilparant's dose consistency despite favorable safety profiles.

AMRN.title: Here's Why You Should Add ANRO Stock to Your Portfolio Now
AMRN.summary: Alto Neuroscience (ANRO), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, is advancing its precision psychiatry pipeline with three key candidates. ALTO-300 and ALTO-100 are in phase IIb studies with top-line results expected in H1 2027 and mid-2027 respectively. ALTO-101 for schizophrenia-related cognitive impairment failed its primary endpoint but showed some secondary signals. Year-to-date, ANRO shares have risen 24.1%, outperforming the biotech industry's 2.9% growth.

However, rising non-interest expenses, weakening asset quality with 16.6% growth in non-accrual loans, and modest mortgage banking income present headwinds. The company's exit from near-prime auto lending is expected to improve liquidity and funding profile.

TFCpR.title: State Street Stock Falls Despite Q3 Earnings Beat & Record AUM Levels
TFCpR.summary: State Street reported Q3 2026 earnings of $3.69 per share, beating estimates of $3.65, with net income up 28.4% year-over-year. However, shares fell 9% pre-market due to net inflows plummeting to $7B from $114B, revenues missing estimates at $4B, and management raising 2026 expense growth guidance to 8-8.5%. The company did achieve record AUM of $6.31T and AUC/A of $59.17T.

TTWO.title: A Blockbuster Video Game Release Could Reginite This Stock
TTWO.summary: Take-Two Interactive (TTWO) is positioned for significant growth with the November 19th release of Grand Theft Auto VI. Building on GTA 5's massive success—nearly 230 million copies sold and over a decade of monetization—GTA 6 is expected to drive major revenue acceleration. The company forecasts $8.0-$8.2 billion in net bookings for FY27, representing ~20% growth, with consensus estimates showing 71% earnings growth in FY27 and 40% in FY28. Trading at 24.4X forward earnings, well below the five-year median of 37.3X, the stock appears undervalued given the growth catalyst.

TTWO.title: PENN or TTWO: Which Is the Better Value Stock Right Now?
TTWO.summary: A comparison of two gaming sector stocks reveals that PENN Entertainment offers better value for investors compared to Take-Two Interactive. PENN has a stronger Zacks Rank (#1 Strong Buy vs #3 Hold), lower valuation multiples (P/E of 14.95 vs 29.66, PEG of 0.46 vs 1.08), and a superior Value grade (A vs F), making it the more attractive option for value-focused investors.

APT.title: Zacks Initiates Coverage of APT With Neutral Recommendation
APT.summary: Zacks Investment Research initiated coverage of Alpha Pro Tech, Ltd. (APT) with a 'Neutral' recommendation. The company benefits from strong growth in disposable protective apparel (up 24.9% YoY), a debt-free balance sheet, and improved operating margins. However, rising input costs, tariff uncertainty, and weakness in the housing-sensitive Building Supply segment pose near-term headwinds. APT trades at a valuation discount compared to subindustry peers.

JPEQF.title: Core Inflation Just Accelerated. The Fed Is Listening.
JPEQF.summary: September's Consumer Price Index showed headline inflation at 3.7% year-over-year, but the concerning metric was core inflation accelerating to 2.6% from 2.4% in August. This acceleration suggests broader price pressures beyond energy and could support another Fed rate hike by December. The higher discount rates resulting from potential rate hikes pose a particular risk to long-duration assets like high-growth AI stocks, which carry elevated valuations dependent on future cash flows.

LTM.title: Are Options Traders Betting on a Big Move in LATAM Airlines Stock?
LTM.summary: LATAM Airlines Group (LTM) is experiencing elevated implied volatility in its November 2026 $30 call options, signaling market expectations for significant price movement. However, the fundamental outlook remains weak, with the company holding a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating and analysts reducing earnings estimates from $1.18 to $1.07 per share over the last 60 days. The high volatility may present opportunities for options traders to sell premium and capture decay.

GS.title: MS Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Equity Trading and Wealth Growth
GS.summary: Morgan Stanley reported Q3 2026 earnings of $3.03 per share, beating consensus estimates of $2.83, with net revenues rising 11.6% to $20.34 billion. Wealth Management revenues hit a record $9.07 billion with $8.43 trillion in total client assets, while Institutional Securities benefited from a 40.9% surge in equity revenues. However, Investment Management faced headwinds with an 11.6% revenue decline due to performance fee pressures. The company carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating due to elevated expenses and volatile trading revenues.

GS.title: GS Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Financing Growth and AI Risks
GS.summary: Goldman Sachs reported Q3 2026 earnings of $17.01 per share, beating consensus estimates of $12.90, with revenues reaching $18.68 billion. The bank saw strong performance in equities revenues (up 72% to $6.44B) driven by derivatives and financing demand, and investment banking fees rose 21% to $3.22 billion. However, management cautioned that rising interest rates and escalating financing costs could undermine returns on infrastructure projects, while maintaining disciplined capital deployment and returning $3 billion in share repurchases.

GS.title: Goldman Q3 Earnings Beat on Strong Equities & IB Revenues, Shares Rise
GS.summary: Goldman Sachs reported strong Q3 2026 earnings with EPS of $17.01, beating estimates by 31.9% and jumping 39% year-over-year. Net revenues rose 23% to $18.68B, driven by a 72% surge in Equities revenues to $6.44B and 21% increase in investment banking fees to $3.22B. Asset & Wealth Management revenues grew 14% with record assets under supervision of $4.10T. Despite higher operating expenses and credit provisions, the company maintained an 18.7% annualized return on equity and returned $4.49B to shareholders.

GS.title: Small-Business Optimism Dips in September
GS.summary: Pre-market futures showed mixed signals as investors paused on AI stocks, with the Dow up 420 points while the Nasdaq fell 217 points. Oil prices dropped 1.5% amid Middle East tensions, and bond yields declined. Small business optimism dipped for the second consecutive month in September. Major financial institutions reported Q3 earnings with mixed results: JPMorgan Chase missed estimates, Goldman Sachs significantly beat expectations, Wells Fargo delivered mixed results, and Johnson & Johnson beat on earnings but missed slightly on revenue.

GS.title: Mixed Pre-Markets Greet Fresh Q3 Earnings Reports
GS.summary: Pre-market futures showed mixed signals on October 13, 2026, with the Dow up 420 points while the Nasdaq fell 217 points. Growth is driven by increasing cyber threats to military networks, AI-driven defense solutions, space-based security demands, and defensive cyber operations. The Middle East is positioned for the second-highest regional growth rate.

EADSY.title: EADSY vs. ESLT: Which Stock Is the Better Value Option?
EADSY.summary: A comparison of two aerospace-defense stocks reveals that Airbus SE (EADSY) presents a better value opportunity than Elbit Systems (ESLT). HON.title: Software Critical for TSOs to Enhance Grid Resilience, ABI Research Finds
HON.summary: A survey of 151 Transmission System Operators across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific reveals that cybersecurity is their top concern. TSOs are increasing software investments in Energy Management Systems, grid planning software, and Grid Enhancing Technologies to modernize aging infrastructure and expand grid capacity. Vendors are advised to emphasize security credibility, interoperability, and operational value rather than relying solely on AI differentiation.

HON.title: Should First Trust Dow 30 Equal Weight ETF (EDOW) Be on Your Investing Radar?

CARL.title: Carlsmed Launches aprevo® Lumbar Bi-lateral Posterior System
CARL.summary: Carlsmed, Inc. announced the U.S. commercial launch of its aprevo® Lumbar Bi-lateral Posterior System at the North American Spine Society's 41st Annual Meeting. FEMY.title: Femasys Doubles Enrolling Sites in FemBloc FINALE Pivotal Trial for Non-Surgical Permanent Birth Control
FEMY.summary: Femasys Inc. announced it has doubled the number of actively enrolling sites in its FemBloc FINALE Pivotal Trial to twelve across the United States, including prominent academic centers like Baylor Research Institute and Columbia University Medical Center. The expansion, enabled by August 2026 financing, demonstrates progress in the company's U.S. regulatory strategy for FDA approval of FemBloc, a non-surgical permanent birth control solution already approved in Europe, UK, and New Zealand.

ALDX.title: Syndax Stock Falls 16% as Phase II Fibrosis Study Misses Primary Goal
ALDX.summary: Syndax Pharmaceuticals (SNDX) shares fell 15.7% after its phase II MAXPIRe study of axatilimab failed to meet the primary endpoint in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) treatment. The drug showed no benefit in slowing FVC decline, though it maintained a favorable safety profile. The company is discontinuing IPF development but will continue pursuing axatilimab in chronic graft-versus-host disease (cGVHD) with results expected in 2026 and 2028.

ALDX.title: Here's Why You Should Add ANRO Stock to Your Portfolio Now
ALDX.summary: Alto Neuroscience (ANRO), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, is advancing its precision psychiatry pipeline with three key candidates. ALTO-207 for treatment-resistant depression showed encouraging phase IIa results, with phase IIb results expected in H2 2027. ALTO-300 and ALTO-100 are in phase IIb studies with top-line results expected in H1 2027 and mid-2027 respectively. ALTO-101 for schizophrenia-related cognitive impairment failed its primary endpoint but showed some secondary signals. Year-to-date, ANRO shares have risen 24.1%, outperforming the biotech industry's 2.9% growth.
